english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), intentionally and without lawful authority, intercepted in the United Kingdom, a communication, namely **(..SPECIFY COMMUNICATION..), in the course of its transmission by means of a

(A)_[public telecommunication system]_
(B)_[private telecommunication system]_
(C)_[public postal service]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 3(1) and (6) of the Investigatory Powers Act 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
intentionally
without lawful authority
intercepted a communication in course of transmission
by means of a public telecommunication system/private telecommunication system/public postal service

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions is required.
(ii) See sections 1(2) and 5 for circumstances in which conduct is excluded from criminal liability for the purposes of this offence.
(iii) See section 4 for definition of "intercept a communication in the course of its transmission.
(iv) See section 6 which makes provision about when a person has lawful authority to carry out an interception

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.
